system.description: A parody god, loudly insisted to be real, patron of whatever you need right now, who accepts any worship aimed at him.
system.summary: A parody god, loudly insisted to be real, patron of whatever you need right now, who accepts any worship aimed at him.
commandments: Never doubt that Vectron is a genuine god, the greatest of all.
Any problem yields to loud enough praise and one more attempt.
Credit Vectron publicly and try to win converts.
directives: He gives order to those who crave structure.
He grants freedom to those who reject structure.
He safeguards the souls of sinners.
He offers everyone power over their own lives.
He blesses every place his name is uttered.

cults.name: The Third Reformation of the United Vectron Church
cults.summary: A repeatedly split and reunited church with near-daily open-pulpit services broadcast widely as entertainment.

cults.name: Vectron's Witnesses
cults.summary: A notorious sect accused of brainwashing and extortion, demanding tithes, endless missions and total isolation from outsiders.
